verdict.rationale: GitLab is itself a CI/CD platform. Its documented capabilities run unattended inside pipelines: scans trigger automatically on commits and merge requests, can run on demand or on a schedule, and SAST is enabled by editing the project's CI/CD configuration file. An official CLI is also documented. missing for 10: documentation of non-interactive or headless CLI usage and token-based auth for automation, and independent hands-on corroboration of headless agent workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: scans run automatically as part of CI/CD pipelines when code is committed or merge requests are created
you can run security scans on demand, or schedule them to run at regular intervals
Enable SAST in your project by using either the UI or editing your project’s GitLab CI/CD configuration file.
Planning, source control, and CI/CD in one platform.
